# Voyager Therapeutics to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


by[s2desi5_voyagertherapeutics](https://www.voyagertherapeutics.com/author/s2desi5_voyagertherapeutics/)


| Aug 30, 2023


|[Uncategorized](https://www.voyagertherapeutics.com/category/uncategorized/)


CAMBRIDGE, Mass. , Aug. 30, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Voyager Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: VYGR), a biotechnology company dedicated to breaking through barriers in gene therapy and neurology, today announced that management will participate in the following investor conferences: Wells Fargo Health
